parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The name of the scheduling rule that you want to delete.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo delete-scheduler-rule --resource-group-id default --rule-name testrule --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ddoscoo DeleteSchedulerRule --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceGroupId default --RuleName testrule
